project.name: 玛雅文化海报
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 古代玛雅文明: 翡翠绿与黄金色系、石灰石质感背景、金字塔剪影、阶梯几何图案、象形文字装饰、丛林迷雾氛围
project.designRead: poster / cultural-exhibition / mystical ancient grandeur / low density / avoid neon gradients, modern geometric minimalism, cute/kawaii

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: jade green #2D6B4F for primary accents, gold #B8922E for secondary highlights
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: jade green primary with gold secondary accent, stone neutrals for backgrounds

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: sharp geometric edges, stepped pyramid shapes, angular patterns
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Cinzel for display (Latin ancient feel), Noto Serif SC for Chinese titles, wide letter-spacing for majesty
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: generous vertical spacing, centered ceremonial layout
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: geometric borders, stepped pyramid motifs, glyph-inspired ornaments
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: ancient ruins, jungle, pyramids, glyphs, carved stone

sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: jade green #2D6B4F primary with gold #B8922E accent
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Cinzel display, Noto Serif SC for Chinese, Noto Sans SC for body, wide letter-spacing
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: poster format, no traditional CTA buttons
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: centered ceremonial composition with geometric balance

designSource.designDecisionSummary: 古代玛雅文明: 翡翠绿+黄金色、石灰石质感、金字塔阶梯图案、象形文字装饰、丛林迷雾
